description.narrative:
Voices on the Move is youth-led, tackling the exploitation of marginalised young people through irregular migration and trafficking. Building on experience of the two organisations working on the Youth Advisory Committee (YAC) of the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where young people from Africa and Europe helped shape Dutch and EU policy on migration, the project creates bottom-up policy spaces where young people act as decision-shapers.
Utrecht Youth Network (Netherlands) and Innovative Young Minds for Boundless Impact Initiative (Nigeria) will work across Netherlands and Nigeria over 12 months. Marginalised youth aged 18–35 will co-design and lead policy dialogues, engage local, national, and EU decision-makers, and produce a joint Nigeria–Netherlands Youth Policy Frameworkon migration and youth participation. Through cross-continental cooperation, the project strengthens sustainable, youth-led advocacy and reinforces the role of young voices in AU–EU policymaking.
Primary goal is to sustainyouth-led policymaking across Africa andEurope by creating an independent, cross-continental participation track at a time when formal youth advisory spaces are disappearing. Over 12 months, the project will directly engage at least 100 young people (18–35) through youth-led, in-person dialogues and exchanges in Nigeria and the Netherlands, and reach approximately 500 additional young people online through youth-facilitated digitalengagement.
Short term, the project aims to create accessible, youth-led spaces for dialogue and exchange between young people from countries of origin and destination. Through youth-led physical dialogues, online consultations and joint reflection processes, young people will share experiences, identify common challenges and co-create a Youth Policy Framework and Manifest on migration and youth participation. These outputs will be presented by young people themselves to 30-50 policymakers and institutional stakeholders at local, national and EU levels.
Longer term, theproject aims to strengthen the recognition of young people as legitimate policy actors, improve the quality of youth participation in migration-related policymaking, and establish a sustainable youth policy network. While we know from our experiences policy and advocacy change take time, the project lays concrete foundations for feedbackloops,continued youth-led engagement, follow-up advocacy and long-term influence within AU–EU cooperation.

participating-org.narrative:
Utrecht Youth Network (UYN) is a youth-led, non-profit organisation based in Utrecht, the Netherlands. The organisation was createdby and with young people who aim to contribute to more just, inclusive and engaged communities. UYN is not an organisationfor youngpeople, but a network of young people, where participation, co-creation and shared responsibility are central.
Vision: UYN envisions inclusive societies in which young people are recognised as active contributors to social cohesion, democracy and peace, and where their voices and lived experiences are meaningfully included in societal and political processes.
Mission: The mission of UtrechtYouth Network is to strengthen encounter, empowerment and societal impact by creating safe and inclusive spaces for connection, supporting personal development, and amplifying young people’s voices at local, national and international levels. UYN works bottom-up and believes that sustainable change emerges collectively and from lived experience.
Objectives: UYN works towards three interconnected objectives: - Creating spaces for encounter and connection between people from diverse backgrounds. We build bridges between cultures and backgrounds. - Supporting personal development and empowerment through reflection, learning and active participation. - Strengthening meaningful participation and increasing the visibility of young people’s perspectives in society and policy-making.
These objectives are achieved through local and international projects, linking community-based activities with international cooperation.
Values: UYN is guided by the values of youth participation, inclusivity, diversity, collaboration and bottom-up engagement, ensuring that all involved feel seen, heard and activelyinvolved.
